title: Red team engagement plan
description: RedScanner v0.2 — web assessment automation: ProjectDiscovery stack, nuclei (tag filtering), dalfox XSS on crawled parameterized URLs, sqlmap, api_leak, header_check (OWASP WSTG-CONF), nikto/naabu. Use profile header-only for a quick header audit; april-vuln or full for vuln discovery; compare runs with scan_diff.py. Optional: strict_domain_reports, nuclei_extra_args, nuclei_tags, nuclei_exclude_tags.
methodology_frameworks: NIST SP 800-115 — Technical Guide for Security Testing

manual_phases.name: May — RedScanner v0.2 (see assets/May.txt)
tasks: Quick header audit: python main.py --profile header-only
Vuln scan: april-vuln or full; tune nuclei_tags / nuclei_exclude_tags (default excludes dos,fuzz)
Regression: python scan_diff.py output/<target>/<old>/report.json output/<target>/<new>/report.json --output diff.json
Confirm dalfox file-mode XSS against parameterized URLs from xcrawl3r crawl output
Triangulate automated findings manually before customer delivery

manual_phases.name: April — vulnerability discovery for the scoped domain
tasks: Run april-vuln (vuln-focused) or full (adds naabu + nikto) against the authorized hostname; enable strict_domain_reports (or --strict-domain) for customer-facing reports that exclude off-host noise
Optionally set nuclei_extra_args in red_plan.json (e.g. ["-as"] for active scan) after reviewing nuclei documentation and rate limits
Use nuclei_tags (e.g. ["cve","oast"]) and nuclei_exclude_tags (e.g. ["dos","fuzz"]) to focus template selection
Review header_check findings for missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options) — quick wins for hardening reports
Triangulate nuclei/dalfox/sqlmap hits with Burp/ZAP; confirm impact before reporting
